center.title: Medical centre
center.lead: Several doctors under one roof: each with their own account, team, patients, money and website — sharing the reception and the waiting screen, and the cash screen for those who choose.
center.removed: The clinic was removed from the centre.

done.call-in: Patient sent in to the doctor.
done.uncall: Patient back in the waiting room.

err.CENTER_ALREADY: This clinic is already in a medical centre.
err.CENTER_INVITE_INVALID: This invitation is no longer valid.
err.CENTER_FOUNDER: The founding clinic stays in the centre.
err.CENTER_PERCENT_100: The percentages must add up to 100.
err.CENTER_CUSTOM_TOTAL: The clinics' amounts must add up to the total.
err.CENTER_SHARE_PAID: A clinic has already paid its share of this expense.
err.CENTER_SALARIES_DONE: This month's salaries were already posted.
err.CENTER_NO_SALARIES: No shared staff with a salary.

mail.subject: Invitation to join {center}
mail.body: You are invited to open your clinic in {center}. Your clinic keeps its own account, team, patients, money and website, and shares the reception and the waiting screen with the other clinics.
mail.account_body: Hello {name}, an account was opened for your clinic in {center}. Your clinic has its own patients, team and money. Set your password to start.

center.signup_invited_help: Your clinic with its own account — sharing only the reception and the waiting screen with the other clinics.
center.type_clinic_help: One or more doctors on one account, one team and shared accounts.
center.type_center_help: Each doctor with their own account, staff, expenses and website — sharing the reception and waiting screen.
center.center_name_help: Invite the other doctors from the Medical centre page after signing up.
center.practice_name_help: Your own clinic's name inside the centre (on your website and invoices).
center.invite_invalid: This invitation expired or was already used. Ask the centre for a new one.
center.join_lead: Open your clinic in the centre, or bring a clinic you own.
center.join_new: A new clinic in the centre
center.join_new_help: A new account for your clinic with its team, money and website.
center.join_existing_help: Its data stays as it is; it joins the shared reception.
center.join_what: Shared: today's appointments and waiting list at the reception and on the waiting screen (name, time, doctor). Yours alone: patient records, team, invoices, expenses, website, e-mail and domain.
center.create_help: Your clinic becomes the centre's first clinic; then invite the other doctors by e-mail.

how.separate: Each doctor has a separate account: team, patients, invoices, expenses and salaries.
how.desk: A shared reception sees every clinic's appointments today, checks patients in and sends them in.
how.screen: One waiting screen for the whole centre (choose “All clinics of the centre” when creating it).
how.cash: A shared cash screen for those who choose; each invoice stays in its clinic with its own numbering.
how.site: Each doctor has their own website, e-mail and domain.

center.join_by_invite: To join an existing centre: open the invitation link you received by e-mail.
center.remove_confirm: Remove {name} from the centre? Its data stays as it is.
center.invite_help: A link by e-mail to open their clinic in the centre or bring one they own.
center.invite_link: Invitation link (you can copy and send it)
center.cash_own_help: Your patients pay on your clinic's screen only.
center.cash_shared_help: Your visits appear on the centre's shared cash screen (the invoice stays in your clinic).
center.leave_confirm: Take your clinic out of the centre?
center.practices_sub: Each doctor has a separate account: own patients, team, money and website. Only the reception, the waiting screen and the shared costs are shared.
center.add_doctor_help: Opens a separate clinic account for the doctor inside the centre and sends them a link to set their password. If the email already has an account, an invitation to join is sent instead.
center.doctor_email_help: The doctor signs in with this email.
center.account_link_emailed: We emailed the password link. You can also send it yourself:
center.account_link_copy: Send this link to the doctor to set the password (valid for 7 days):
center.staff_sub: People who work for the whole centre (reception, cleaning, accountant…). Their salaries can be split among the clinics.
center.salary_help: Leave 0 if the salary is not shared.
center.login_email_help: To let them use the shared reception and cash screen. They sign in to the centre admin account only.
center.staff_remove_confirm: Remove this staff member? Their login (if any) is disabled.
center.temp_password_help: Shown only once. They are asked to change it at first sign-in.
center.expenses_sub: Rent, electricity, salaries… each split among the clinics.
center.expense_delete_confirm: Delete this shared expense? Not possible once a clinic has paid its share.
center.custom_help: The amounts must add up to the total.
center.expense_added: The expense was added and each clinic was notified of its share.
center.salaries_help: Posts this month's salaries of the shared staff ({total}) as a shared expense split among the clinics.
center.salaries_posted: The salaries were posted and split.
center.split_sub: How shared costs are split unless chosen otherwise. Percentages must add up to 100.
center.costs_hint: See what your clinic owes the centre
center.costs_lead: Your clinic's share of the medical centre's shared expenses. Paying a share records it in your clinic's expenses.
center.pay_confirm: Record this share as paid from your clinic?
center.share_paid: The share was paid and recorded in your expenses.
